title: FemTheme Solo #002 · 여 바이올린 힙 아워글래스·웨이쉰·천사 테마
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a bright white-sand beach at midday with calm turquoise water, a wooden boardwalk with a waist-high rail and a row of closed striped cabanas of normal door height, warmly lit by the low golden sun, long soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her, NO dark background NO black void, ONE person standing, sharp focus from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in warm golden-hour sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

SUBJECT: ONE real adult Chinese woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, clear fair skin, a warm rose-red wash blended across the outer corners of both eyes and drifting up toward the temples, the same flush spreading softly across the cheekbones and the bridge of the nose, slightly smudged, dewy highlights, soft brown-pink eyeshadow, large moist eyes with bright real catchlights and a faint glassy shine, moist rose-tinted lips, a dreamy, half-lidded expression, dark roots fading smoothly into sun-kissed lighter ends (balayage) hair styled in countless fine micro braids, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large gold hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a tin pyramid-shaped lump, a gold teardrop-shaped sinker), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and four to six layered mixed-metal anklets. Extremely long round nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
SUBJECT Physique: an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a sharply cinched waist rises out of hips that sweep outward in a single smooth violin-shaped curve, the hips and thick rounded thighs flaring many times wider than the waist and dominating her silhouette from the front and side, a firm high rounded rear, a full round bust balancing the curve above; the line from waist to hip to thigh is one long unbroken curve; not thin, not boyish, not a straight figure; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
SUBJECT Outfit: Her skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a thin golden halo floating above her head and a pair of large white feathered angel wings attached at her back, a tiny white satin micro-bikini top of two small opaque triangle cups on thin strings tied at the neck and back, fully covering her bust, and a minimal white satin micro bikini bottom of one tiny low-rise opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque piece fully covering her, her stomach fully visible.
SUBJECT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on her hip.
SUBJECT Footwear: Extreme gold thigh-high stiletto boots with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the warm low sun in glowing glints, the golden light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, the face toward the camera.
